overview: Most people get weak results because they ask in a vague way. We write a short guide in your own business language that shows how to ask for what you need, with ready examples for tasks you do every week, such as supplier emails, product notes, social posts or meeting summaries. Each example shows the prompt, a sample result and what to check before using it.

faq: Will the prompts work in any AI tool?
They are written to work in the main chat tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Small differences between tools are noted where they matter.
Are the prompts specific to my business?
Yes. We ask about your products, tone and recurring tasks, and write examples with your real situations, not generic ones. Private details are never needed.
How should my team store the guide?
As an editable document in Google Docs, Notion or Word, so people can add their own prompts. We suggest a simple way to keep it tidy.
Do the prompts replace checking the result?
No. Every guide includes a short check list for facts, names and tone. AI can be wrong, so a person should read anything customers will see.
